#    11.345  note: terminator test 'lf': the robot sent 'ERR;1' (CMD_NOT_EXECUTED) on S2 (after INFO), probably its answer to 'INFO\n', a command it did not recognise. GFW 01.02.00 sends nothing for an unknown command, so either this firmware differs there or the error was unsolicited
#    11.345  note: terminator test 'crlf': the robot sent 'ERR;1' (CMD_NOT_EXECUTED) on S2 (after INFO), probably its answer to 'INFO\r\n', a command it did not recognise. GFW 01.02.00 sends nothing for an unknown command, so either this firmware differs there or the error was unsolicited
